title: Find a dance partner
intro: Meet people to practise, take classes or go social dancing with. Partner search works only between people who chose to take part.
howConsent: Nobody is listed by default. A person appears only for the styles where they ticked “looking for a partner” themselves, and they can untick them at any time.
howReciprocity: It is mutual: to see others you have to be visible yourself, so you need at least one style of your own marked as “looking for a partner”.
howPrivacy: Only the city and district are shown. Distances are calculated on the server and shown as a rough range, never as an address or a point on a map.
howInterest: Interest is private. The other person finds out only if they are interested in you too; then you both get a notification.
howSafety: Every card has Report and Block. Blocking hides you from each other and removes any interest between you.
need_UNAUTHORIZED: Partner search is available to signed-in members only. Sign in to continue.
need_VERIFY_EMAIL: Please confirm your email address first: follow the link in the message we sent you, then come back to this page.
need_BANNED: Partner search is not available for this account.
need_PROFILE_HIDDEN: Your profile is currently hidden by moderators, so partner search is not available.
need_PROFILE_REQUIRED: You need a profile before you can search for a partner.
need_LOOKING_FOR_REQUIRED: To search, tick “I am looking for a partner” for at least one style in the skills section of your profile. This makes you visible to others for those styles only, and you can switch it off at any time.
openSkills: Open the skills editor in my profile
mineText: You are visible in partner search for these styles only:
radiusHint: A distance replaces the city filter. It is measured from your saved approximate location, or from the centre of your city if you have not saved one.
filterSubStyles: Include sub-styles of the chosen style
filterWiden: Show all levels, not only levels close to mine
filterRules: You see people with a compatible role: leaders see followers, followers see leaders, and “both” matches everyone. By default the level is within one step of yours.
resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody found} one {# person found} other {# people found}}
noResults: Nobody matches these filters yet. Try another style, a wider distance or all levels.
safetyNote: Partner search is for dancing. If somebody uses it for anything else or makes you uncomfortable, report or block them right from their card: moderators review every report.
matchesIntro: You and these dancers are interested in each other. Write to them to arrange a practice or a class.
noMatches: No mutual matches yet. When somebody you are interested in is interested in you too, they will appear here and you will get a notification.
sentIntro: People you showed interest in who have not answered yet. They do not know about it, and you can withdraw at any time.
interestPrivate: Saved. They will find out only if the interest is mutual.
matchedNow: It is mutual: {name} is interested too.
blockConfirm: Block {name}? You will stop seeing each other in partner search, and any interest between you will be removed. They will not be told.
locationText: Optional. Your position is rounded to an area of about two kilometres before it is saved; the exact point is never stored and never shown to anyone. Others see only your city, district and a rough distance range.
locationOff: No location is saved: distances are measured from the centre of your city.
error_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
error_BANNED: This account cannot use partner search.
error_PROFILE_HIDDEN: Your profile is hidden, so partner search is not available.
error_LOOKING_FOR_REQUIRED: Mark at least one of your own styles as “looking for a partner” first.
error_STYLE_NOT_ALLOWED: You can search only in the styles where you are looking for a partner yourself.
error_LOCATION_REQUIRED: Choose a city, or add a city to your profile, to search by distance.

error_INVALID_INPUT: Some of the values are not valid. Check the filters and try again.

error_GEOLOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: Your location could not be determined. You can still search by city.
